vibe: Patch the web stack first: Brotli-based RCEs have widened beyond Node.js, CISA has added two exploited enterprise flaws, and AI-agent isolation is becoming core infrastructure.

cyber.title: HTTP2Shell expands Node2Shell-style RCE risk across Node.js, Python and more
cyber.summary: The Brotli decoder issue is no longer a Node-only concern: affected libraries and runtimes include Python and other widely used stacks. Inventory Brotli consumers and apply upstream runtime/package fixes urgently, especially on internet-facing services.

cyber.title: CISA flags exploited critical flaws in Collabora Online and Arista VeloCloud
cyber.summary: CISA has added two critical, actively exploited enterprise-product flaws to its catalogue. Teams running Collabora Online or Arista VeloCloud should identify exposed instances, patch immediately and review logs for compromise.

cyber.title: Leaked LiteLLM master key exposed GitHub tokens and the release pipeline
cyber.summary: A leaked LiteLLM master key enabled attackers to reach GitHub credentials and hijack the software release path. The incident is a sharp reminder to isolate AI gateways, scope CI tokens tightly and rotate secrets after any control-plane exposure.

cyber.title: Capcom confirms breach affecting 11.7 million users
cyber.summary: Capcom says 11.7 million users were affected. Expect convincing game-themed phishing and credential-stuffing attempts; affected users should distrust unsolicited account messages and change reused passwords.

cyber.title: BlackX UEFI bootkit bypasses Secure Boot through Baton Drop
cyber.summary: BlackX can exploit incomplete Secure Boot revocations to persist below the operating system. Windows fleet hygiene now needs firmware updates and current revocation databases, not merely monthly OS patches.

cyber.title: Abandoned Popcorn Time updater exposed millions of devices to RCE
cyber.summary: An abandoned update channel left millions of installations open to remote code execution. Researchers remotely disabled the updater, but remaining installations should be removed because abandoned auto-update mechanisms are durable supply-chain liabilities.

cyber.title: PHP Meltdown shows how AI shortens the path from bug to exploit
cyber.summary: The PHP episode illustrates the new compression of disclosure-to-exploitation time: AI-assisted discovery and weaponisation raise the premium on rapid patching, asset inventory and compensating controls.

cyber.title: Autonomous attack agent hijacks other models to execute intrusions
cyber.summary: Researchers demonstrated an offensive agent delegating tasks to other models while pursuing an attack. The practical takeaway is to treat agents as privileged automation: constrain tools, credentials, network access and inter-agent trust.

ai.title: OpenAI stops frontier-model training from accessing the live internet
ai.summary: OpenAI says its frontier training environments will no longer have live internet access, citing meaningful security risks. It is a strong signal that network isolation is becoming baseline practice for high-capability model development.

ai.title: Anthropic releases sandbox-runtime for OS-level agent isolation
ai.summary: Anthropic's sandbox-runtime offers OS-level isolation for AI agents without requiring containers. For cloud engineers, the interesting part is the lighter-weight containment model for local tools and coding agents.

ai.title: NVIDIA releases 4GB Nemotron 3.5 Bolt model for local agents
ai.summary: NVIDIA's compact open model targets local voice agents, games and robotics in a 4GB footprint. Worth noting as capable models continue moving onto edge hardware with lower latency and privacy exposure.

ai.title: Google DeepMind open-sources DetectorScope for explainable AI-text detection
ai.summary: DetectorScope aims to show the evidence behind an AI-text classification rather than returning a black-box score. It is early, but explainability is the right direction for a notoriously unreliable category.

it.title: OBS Studio 33 released
it.summary: OBS Studio 33 is out and drew strong developer attention. Streamers and production users should review plugin compatibility and release notes before upgrading live systems.

it.title: Twelve years of distributed SQLite
it.summary: The rqlite maintainer reflects on twelve years of putting consensus and clustering around SQLite. It is useful architecture reading on reliability, trade-offs and operating a deceptively simple distributed system.

videos.title: Bitwarden's license change, Ubuntu AI assistant, LibreOffice breaks records — Linux Weekly News
videos.verdict: SKIM — jump to the Bitwarden licensing and PHP2Shell sections; the rest is a broad Linux roundup.
videos.summary: A wide-ranging Linux briefing covers Bitwarden moving official clients under a commercial licence, Linux kernel 7.3, more Rust in the kernel, an Ubuntu AI-assistant prototype and the PHP2Shell emergency.

videos.title: Introducing Agent Gateway
videos.verdict: WATCH — under a minute and directly relevant to agent governance.
videos.summary: Google presents Agent Gateway as an open, multi-cloud control point for agent registration, authorization, guardrails and observability. It is a product teaser rather than a technical walkthrough, but the governance pattern is sound.
